messages:
natalie: postmortem follow-up: recurring failures around token rotation. i want concrete owners + short timelines so this doesn't slip.
sam: i'll take rotation automation and CI guards. plan is to add a gate that simulates key roll and verifies zero auth errors. ETA 4 days.
diego: i'll own audit logging changes 10 include `rotation_event` with kid and issuer; retention proposal: 90d hot, 1y cold.
meera: ops note 10 deploy bursts in ap-south seem to correlate with spikes. suggest phased deploys and a reload signal instead of full restarts.
infra-bot: created task TASK-9988: "token rotation hardening" (https://issues.redwood/TASK-9988)
natalie: ownership draft: automation -> sam, audit -> diego, deploy cadence + reload -> meera, customer comms + runbook -> natalie. deadlines: owners add triage + blocker ETA by EOW.
sam: test plan: inject rotation in staging, restart pods with staggered windows, monitor auth failures. example command i'll use: `kubectl exec -n staging $(pgrep -f svc) -- ./rotate-key && sleep 3 && curl -i localhost:8080/health`
diego: mapping posted to TASK-9988. also adding a kibana saved search for `auth.rotation` events.
meera: i'll change deploy controller to 3-phase rollout for critical services and add a SIGHUP handler to trigger key reload. ETA next week.
natalie: alert proposal: `rotation.auth_error_rate > 0.3% over 5m` -> page oncall + create follow-up ticket to owners. will also post daily digest in #incidents for first week after rollout.
sam: will add CI job and alert integration. i'll link PR and update TASK-9988 when green.
diego: i'll include sample queries and retention config in the ticket.
natalie: summary action items: sam: CI rotation gate + cron test (ETA 4d) | diego: audit event + kibana view (ETA 3d) | meera: phased deploys + reload handler (ETA 1w) | natalie: runbook + comms + alert (ETA 2d). update TASK-9988 with status. :thumbsup:
infra-bot: reminder set: status sync in 5 days.
natalie: thanks team, will schedule a 30m sync after owners post initial triage."
